disclaimer: Annotations are plain-language guidance for this viewer. They explain the frozen field names and do not represent generated results.

goal.label: Goal
goal.description: The outcome the requested change should achieve.

current_behavior_or_symptom.label: Current behavior or symptom
current_behavior_or_symptom.description: What happens now, including the observable problem when relevant.

expected_behavior.label: Expected behavior
expected_behavior.description: What should happen after the requested change.

target_component.label: Target component
target_component.description: The area of the codebase intended to change.

relevant_symbol_or_api.label: Relevant symbol or API
relevant_symbol_or_api.description: A function, class, interface, or endpoint related to the request.

affected_consumers.label: Affected consumers
affected_consumers.description: Callers or users whose behavior may be influenced by the change.

compatibility.label: Compatibility
compatibility.description: Behavior or interfaces that should continue to work.

boundary_and_error_semantics.label: Boundary and error semantics
boundary_and_error_semantics.description: Required behavior at limits, invalid inputs, and failure conditions.

excluded_scope.label: Excluded scope
excluded_scope.description: Related work that is intentionally outside the requested change.

acceptance_criteria.label: Acceptance criteria
acceptance_criteria.description: Observable conditions that define a successful implementation.

relevant_tests_or_checks.label: Relevant tests or checks
relevant_tests_or_checks.description: Focused verification that should demonstrate the expected behavior.
